CustomField.description: CloseDate formerly First Bill Date, Booked Date is now First Bill Date.
CustomField.formula:
CASE((VALUE(MID(TEXT(CloseDate),1,4)) - VALUE(MID(TEXT(TODAY()),1,4))),
-1, "Last Year", 0, "Current Year", 1, "Next Year", 2, "Future", 3, "Future", 4, "Future", 5, "Future", "More than 1 year old")
CustomField.label: Active Pipeline Indicator (FORMULA)
